description: Expander for the Clocked Random Gates module, placed immediately to its right, comparing the eight gates against a chosen set to produce AND and OR outputs

params.text: Includes that channel's gate in the comparison while it is lit, and leaves it out while it is unlit
Chooses when the comparison is made: O for any change of gate, and G, T, GC or C to evaluate on the rising edge of the chosen row's gate, trigger, gated clock, or the incoming clock
Picks which of the eight rows supplies the signal the comparison is timed to

outputs.text: 10V while at least one of the gates switched on is high, and 0V otherwise
10V while every gate switched on is high, and 0V otherwise

menu: Initialize Logic Values Only — puts the eight channel buttons back to their default positions
Randomize Logic Values Only — sets the eight channel buttons at random
